text:
Lina: Heads-up: planning to onboard EdgeServe (trial SKU) into AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Need to confirm images, offer metadata, legal text, and pricing model before we schedule the staging publish.
Ben: +1. Can we standardize a manifest shape first so infra/legal know what to expect?
Carlos: Infra needs: AWS AMI id, GCP image name, Azure VHD path, plus a small TF outputs file with `publisher_id`, `listing_bucket`, `kms_arn`. Also add `recommended_gpu_family` field.
Asha: Legal asks: EULA draft (redlines ok), short DPA paragraph, export/control statement, and a one-line privacy note for the listing. Telemetry retention needs to be set (default 60 days) and PII must be excluded.
PartnerOps: I created a staging publisher entry and uploaded preliminary assets to the shared vault: SVG + 1200x640 PNG, short/long copy, and an example manifest skeleton. Links in 1Password.
Ben: Pricing decision: do we do a 14-day trial with per-seat or a 30-day flat trial? My vote: 14-day + metered seats.
Lina: 14-day metered works. Add trial terms to the manifest under `pricing.trial_days`.
Carlos: For Azure, we also need the publisher tenant ID and a minimal ARM snippet. For GCP, provide a gcloud importable tarball or image name. Example TF output I expect:```
publisher_id = "987654321098"
listing_bucket = "redwood-marketplace-staging"
kms_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:987654321098:key/abcd1234"
```
Asha: I'll draft the EULA/DPA and post to Drive by Wed EOD. Telemetry text: "Aggregated usage stats retained 60 days; no PII captured; opt-out available." Put that in the legal notes section of the manifest.
PartnerOps: Uploaded AMI `ami-0c1d2e3f`, GCP image `edgeserve-stg-2026-05-01`, and Azure VHD `edgeserve-stg.vhd` to storage container `rp-market-images`. Posted links and checksum.
MarketQA: QA note 1: marketplace listings require a short demo video link or screenshots. Can product provide a 60s clip?
Lina: Product will provide 3 screenshots + a short demo clip by Fri.
Ben: Manifest skeleton snippet: {"offerId":"<placeholder>","sku":"edgeserve-trial","pricing":{"trial_days":14,"model":"per_seat"},"recommended_instance":"g5.xlarge"} — will refine.
Carlos: We'll leave instance pinning optional but include `recommended_instance` and `min_vcpu`.
PartnerOps: I'll open support tickets with AWS/GCP/Azure to pre-map entitlements and ask for pre-approval window.
Lina: Action items: 1) Carlos 1 TF outputs + ARM/GCP pointers by EOD. 2) Asha 1 EULA + DPA by Wed. 3) PartnerOps 1 final offerId + asset checksums posted. 4) Ben 1 draft manifest to 1Password under `marketplace/manifests/edgeserve.json`. We aim for a staging publish next Tue morning.
Ben: Will post manifest to 1Password and tag infra/legal.
Asha: Uploading legal drafts now, will ping when available.
PartnerOps: Offer metadata posted: offerId `redwood-edgeserve-002`, publisher display `Redwood Inference`, sku `edgeserve-trial-v1`. All assets verified.
MarketQA: I'll queue a preflight checklist once manifest + images are final.
Lina: Great work team. Ping @Lina if anything blocks. Dry-run publish scheduled in staging on Tue. :rocket:
